messages.subject: Initialization Error
parts:
Hi,

This is my first time posting, so hopefully I provide all the information necessary. 

I am working with survival data and I cannot get my covariates to initialize correctly. I have different variations of this model, containing these covariates, and it has initialized in the past. In blue you can find the slight change in this model which now is giving me initialization problems. These initialization problems are producing NA's for all of my derived parameters when I run my MCMC. 

This is the code I am working with;

state.transition<- nimbleFunction(
  run = function(records = double(0), 
                 Left2=double(1),
                 Right = double(1), 
                 time_effect = double(1), 
                 beta0 = double(0), 
                 age_offset = double(1),
                 agegroup_indx = double(2), 
                 nT_all = double(0),
                 beta1 = double(0),
                 Population = double(1),
                 n_causes = double(0),
                 Cause = double(1),
                 records_cause = double(0),
                 beta2 = double(0),
                 WSI_scaled = double(1)
                 
  ){

    SLR <- nimNumeric(records)
    UCH <-nimMatrix(value = 0,nrow = records, ncol = nT_all)

    for (j in 1:records) {
      for (k in Left2[j]:(Right[j]-1)) {
        UCH[j,k] <- exp(beta0 + beta1*Population[j] + age_offset[agegroup_indx[j,k]] + time_effect[k] + beta2*WSI_scaled[j])
      }
      SLR[j] <- exp(-sum(UCH[j,Left2[j]:(Right[j]-1)]))
    }#end of j

    returnType(double(1))
    return(SLR[1:records])
  })


Cstate.transition <- compileNimble(state.transition)


modelcode <- nimbleCode({
 
  # Priors
  beta0_temp ~ dnorm(0,.01)
  mix ~ dunif(-1,1)
  beta0 <-beta0_temp * mix
  beta1 ~ dnorm(0,.01) #Population
  beta2 ~ dnorm(0,.01) #WSI
 
 
  #ICAR time effect
  tau_time ~ dgamma(1,1)
  for (k in 1:nknots_time) {
    b_time[k] ~ dnorm(0, tau_time)
  }
 
  for (t in 1:nT_all) {
    time_effect[t] <- inprod(b_time[1:nknots_time], Z_time[t, 1:nknots_time])
  }

 
  age_offset[3] <- 0
  for(i in 1:2){
    age_offset[i] ~ dnorm(0,0.01)
  }
 
  ##########################
  ### Cause-specific
  ##########################
 
  #true probability of cause of death
  p[1:n_causes] ~ ddirich(alpha[1:n_causes])
 
  # Likelihood cause of death
  for (i in 1:records_cause) {
    phi[i] <- -log(p[Cause[i]])
    z[i] ~ dpois(phi[i])
  }
 
  SLR[1:records]<-state.transition(records=records,
                                   Left2 = Left2[1:records],
                                   Right = Right[1:records],
                                   time_effect = time_effect[1:nT_all],
                                   beta0 = beta0,
                                   beta1 = beta1,
                                   beta2 = beta2,
                                   agegroup_indx = agegroup_indx[1:records, 1:nT_all],
                                   age_offset = age_offset[1:3],
                                   nT_all = nT_all,
                                   Population = Population[1:records],
                                   n_causes = n_causes,
                                   records_cause = records_cause,
                                   Cause = Cause[1:records_cause],
                                   WSI_scaled = WSI_scaled[1:records])
 
 
  for (j in 1:records) {
    Censor[j] ~ dbern(SLR[j])
  }
 
  ##########################
  ####Derived parameters####
  ##########################
 
  for (t in 1:nT_all){
    llambda_north[t,1]<-beta0 + age_offset[1] + time_effect[t] + beta2*WSI_scaled[t]
    llambda_north[t,2]<-beta0 + age_offset[2] + time_effect[t] + beta2*WSI_scaled[t]
    llambda_north[t,3]<-beta0 + age_offset[3] + time_effect[t] + beta2*WSI_scaled[t]

    for(j in 1:3){
      UCH0_north[t,j] <- exp(llambda_north[t,j])
      CH0_north[t,j] <- sum(UCH0_north[1:t,j])
      S0_north[t,j] <- exp(-CH0_north[t,j])
     
      for (i in 1:5) {
        causehaz_north[i, t, j] <- exp(llambda_north[t, j]) * p[i]
      }#end i
    } #end j
  } #end t
 
  for (t in 244:nT_all){
    llambda_south[t-243,1]<-beta0 + beta1*Population[t] + age_offset[1] + time_effect[t] + beta2*WSI_scaled[t]
    llambda_south[t-243,2]<-beta0 + beta1*Population[t] + age_offset[2] + time_effect[t] + beta2*WSI_scaled[t]
    llambda_south[t-243,3]<-beta0 + beta1*Population[t] + age_offset[3] + time_effect[t] + beta2*WSI_scaled[t]
   
    for(j in 1:3){
      UCH0_south[t-243,j] <- exp(llambda_south[t-243,j])
      CH0_south[t-243,j] <- sum(UCH0_south[1:(t-243),j])  
      S0_south[t-243,j] <- exp(-CH0_south[t-243,j])
     
      for (i in 1:5) {
        causehaz_south[i, t-243, j] <- exp(llambda_south[t-243, j]) * p[i]
      }#end i
    } #end j
  } #end t
})#end model statement

### Data
### must be numeric
nimData <- list(Censor=N.data.fit[,10],
                Z_time = Z_time,
                Left2 = N.data.fit[,11],
                Right = N.data.fit[,9],
                z = rep(0, records_cause)
)

###
### Constants
nimConsts <-list(records = n_fit,
                 nT_all = max(N.data.fit[,9]-1),
                 nknots_time = nknots_time,
                 Population = N.data.fit[,2],
                 Cause = N.data.dead[,1],
                 n_causes = max(N.data.dead[,1]),
                 WSI_scaled = N.data.fit[,12],
                 records_cause = n_fit_cause,
                 agegroup_indx=agegroup_indx
)


initsFun = function()list(
  beta0_temp = rnorm(1,0,0.01),
  mix = 1,
  b_time = rnorm(nknots_time, 0,1),
  beta1 = rnorm(1,0,0.01),
  beta2 = rnorm(1,0,0.01),
  tau_time = runif(1,0.01,0.1),
  age_offset=rep(0,3),
  alpha=rep(1,n_causes),
  p=rep(0.2, n_causes)
)
nimInits = initsFun()



### Build the model, providing data and initial values
modelout<-nimbleModel(code= modelcode,
                      constants = nimConsts,
                      data = nimData,
                      inits = nimInits)
modelout$initializeInfo()

This is what I get when I check what isn't initialized: 
modelout$initializeInfo()
  [Note] Missing values (NAs) or non-finite values were found in model variables: llambda_north, UCH0_north, CH0_north, S0_north, causehaz_north, llambda_south, UCH0_south, CH0_south, S0_south, causehaz_south.
  [Note] This is not an error, but some or all variables may need to be initialized for certain algorithms to operate properly.
  [Note] For more information on model initialization, see help(modelInitialization).

My population covariate is 0,1's while WSI are a range of continuous numbers. Attached is my full code and some test data. 

Thank you! 
Jennifer

Hi Jennifer,

Thanks for posting a question.  (Also I replied off-list and got the code correction Survival.OG <- read.csv("Test.csv"), in case anyone else takes a look. Thanks for that.)

Here is how I started to look around your model, starting with the first variable noted as not fulled initialized:

dim(modelout$llambda_north) # 315 x 3
sum(is.na(modelout$llambda_north)) # 783, so it is mostly NA
modelout$llambda_north # NAs start on row 55
nimConsts$WSI_scaled # This has length 54
nimConsts$nT_all # extent the model wants for WSI_scaled ?

So it looks to me like the NAs in llambda_north begin on row 55 because WSI_scaled only has 54 values but the model code seems to want 315 values for it.  Does that help point in the right direction for debugging?

Perry
